Summary: Shared setup: configure vCenter + Chef Server connection once via .chef/config.rb and validate connectivity
Precondition: knife-vcenter plugin installed/bundled; vCenter lab reachable; Chef Infra Server reachable (if bootstrapped nodes must register); valid credentials for both
Step Detail: 1. Create/update .chef/config.rb (or ~/.chef/config.rb) with: chef_server_url, node_name, client_key (Chef Server identity) and knife[:vcenter_host], knife[:vcenter_username], knife[:vcenter_password], knife[:vcenter_disable_ssl_verify] = true (vCenter identity) ; 2. Run: knife ssl fetch ; 3. Run: knife ssl check
Expected Result: config.rb is valid Ruby and loads without error. 'knife ssl fetch' downloads and trusts the Chef Server's SSL certificate into .chef/trusted_certs with no errors. 'knife ssl check' reports 'Successfully verified certificates from ...' with exit code 0. When running 'knife vcenter *' commands manually from the command line, subsequent commands (TC01-TC13) need NO --vcenter-host/--vcenter-username/--vcenter-password/--vcenter-disable-ssl-verify flags, since they are read from .chef/config.rb automatically. (Note: the automated test/e2e/run_e2e_tests.sh harness always passes these flags explicitly from its own environment variables and does not rely on .chef/config.rb.)
